text:
olivia-sales: Quick heads-upDeltaClinic needs a small assurance packet to clear procurement for a week-long POC: SOC2 control mapping excerpt, ISO cert screenshot, signed pen-test attestation (Redwood or vendor), one-page infra diagram, and a short embeddings dataflow note. Procurement asked if 5 business days is doable.

ben-eng: We can assemble control mapping + auditor cover page (redacted). Network diagram: single-page public ingress -> model serving -> object storage. Confirm hosted vs dedicated detail?

olivia-sales: POC will run on hosted. They want dedicated notes only if they move forward.

sam-security: Pen-test attestation: we have a standard template (pen-letter-v3). Legal needs to sign; if vendor-signed attestation required, that adds vendor coordination. Legal turnaround ~2 business days if no edits. Note: we cannot share raw findings without an NDA.

claire-ps: For embeddings dataflow I'll write a short paragraph: embeddings generated in runtime, ephemeral KV cache, metadata retention defaults to 30d, no raw user messages stored unless configured. I can also include a brief statement about PHI handling.

olivia-sales: Also asked about audit log retention for 12 months and whether that changes price. Any ballpark?

ben-eng: Hosting default is 30d. Extending to 12mo increases storage and compliance handling. Rough estimate: $0.015/GB-month storage plus a one-time ops export setup fee (~$400) if they want historic export. I'll flag to finance for precise pricing.

sam-security: Also confirm whether they need KMS separation attestation. For hosted we say keys are managed by Redwood; Dedicated can bring BYOK. Formal KMS attestation will need 3 business days from Security+Legal.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-1410: Extended log retention quote + presigned TTL request. Owner: @claire-ps.

claire-ps: I'll own OPS-1410. Olivia, can you capture the CISO contact and whether redacted logs are acceptable? If yes, I can bundle docs: control mapping CSV, ISO cert screenshot, one-page diagram (PNG), embeddings paragraph, and draft pen-letter. ETA: end of day Monday if we get CISO today.

olivia-sales: Will confirm CISO and redaction acceptance today and update the thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
